description: List all videos, optionally filtered by category and/or channel. Sorted by published_at descending.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. music, gaming, tech, education).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of video summaries.

description: Retrieve the full video object by vid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full video record.

description: Search videos by keyword across title, description, channel and category.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching video summaries sorted by views desc.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {plid, name, video_ids, created_at}.

description: Retrieve a playlist with expanded video summaries.

description: Remove a video from a playlist.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated playlist record.

description: List the user's recent watch history sorted by watched_at descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of watch history entries.

description: Record a watch event for a video, appending it to history and bumping view count.

progress_seconds.description: How many seconds of the video were watched.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new watch history entry.

description: Delete all watch history entries for the current user.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {cleared: n}.

description: Unsubscribe from a channel by name.

description: Increment the like count for a video.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated video summary.
